clue.text: A key endorsement gives pleasure

parts.note: G is one of the musical keys, so a key here is the single letter naming it
ratification is formal endorsement or approval of an agreement

explanation.surface: Someone is delighted at receiving a key backing or approval.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gives' is a link joining wordplay to definition; the definition is the noun 'pleasure', not 'gives pleasure'.
explanation.definitionFit: Gratification is a synonym for satisfaction or delight, the feeling of having a desire met.

clue.text: Come to hole in the wall where bricks at first have gone missing

indicators.note: something gone missing is no longer there, so this letter is removed from the word

parts.note: a breach is a gap broken through a wall

indicators.note: at first points to the opening letter of the word bricks

explanation.surface: A tale of finding a hole in a wall once some bricks have vanished.
explanation.definitionFit: To reach a place is to arrive at it or come to it.

clue.text: Young swimmer needing a little support

parts.note: a tad is a small amount
a pole is a post that holds something up

explanation.surface: A young swimmer who needs a little help or support.
explanation.definitionFit: A tadpole is the larval form of a frog or toad, which lives and swims in water.

clue.text: A long way to travel, abandoning the east

indicators.note: abandoning means leaving something behind, so this letter is dropped from the word

parts.note: to fare is to travel or get along, as in 'fare forth'
E is the compass abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: Going a long distance while leaving the east behind.
explanation.definitionFit: Far as an adverb means at or to a great distance.

clue.text: Find fault with door woodworking

parts.note: to carp is to complain or nag about small faults
an entry is a way in, such as a door

explanation.surface: Someone criticising a door, perhaps one badly made.
explanation.definitionFit: Carpentry is the craft of working with timber to make and repair things.

clue.text: One finds barrels all around north African port

indicators.note: the barrels are placed all around the other piece, enclosing it

parts.note: a tun is a large cask, for wine or beer
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A traveller finding barrels everywhere in a north African harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Tunis is the capital of Tunisia and a seaport on the Mediterranean coast.

clue.text: The art of speaking in chapel

definitions.meaning: skill in public speaking, eloquent rhetoric
a small chapel or place for private prayer

explanation.surface: Studying rhetoric inside a chapel, perhaps a preacher learning the craft.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both eloquent public speaking and a small place of worship, two unrelated senses.

clue.text: Cavalryman possibly is cut by a marauder

indicators.note: the rider is cut into, with the letter inserted in the middle

parts.note: a cavalryman is one example of a horse rider

explanation.surface: A mounted soldier being wounded by a raiding bandit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' marks a cavalryman as only one kind of rider.
explanation.definitionFit: A raider is someone who makes a sudden attack to plunder, which is what a marauder does.

clue.text: Fugitive losing heart where he comes down after flight

definitions.text: where he comes down after flight

indicators.note: losing the middle letter of the word, its heart

parts.note: a runaway is someone who has fled

explanation.surface: A fleeing man losing courage and coming down after escaping.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flight' reads as fleeing in the surface, but in the definition it means travel by air.
explanation.definitionFit: A runway is the strip where an aircraft lands at the end of its journey.

clue.text: Short-tailed snipe perhaps go away

indicators.note: short-tailed means cut short at the tail, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: to snipe is to shoot from a hidden position, one example of shooting

explanation.surface: Telling a short-tailed wading bird, a snipe, to clear off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'snipe' looks like the bird but works as the verb, to fire from cover.
explanation.definitionFit: Shoo is an exclamation used to drive away an animal or person, meaning be off.

clue.text: Strong dislike of state is back on

parts.note: to aver is to state firmly

indicators.note: back means the little word is is written in reverse

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A strong dislike of the state is back in force.
explanation.definitionFit: Aversion is a feeling of intense distaste or antipathy towards something.

clue.text: Worthy barmaid is upset by ale without a head

indicators.note: by means next to, so one piece sits beside the other
upset means knocked over or thrown into disorder, so the letters are rearranged
without its head means the first letter of the word ale is removed

explanation.surface: A deserving barmaid is distressed by beer that has gone flat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is upset' rearranges BARMAID into ADMIRAB; 'without a head' strips A from ALE to leave LE.
explanation.definitionFit: Admirable describes something deserving praise or respect, so worthy.

clue.text: Son heading side showing energy

indicators.note: heading means coming at the top of, so this letter goes in front

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for son, as in genealogies
a side is a team in sport

explanation.surface: A son leading his team and showing plenty of energy.
explanation.definitionFit: Steam is power or vigour, as in 'running out of steam'.

clue.text: Cheat unpleasant people, netting five-hundred pounds

indicators.note: netting means catching in a net, so these letters enclose the others

parts.note: swine is an insult for nasty people, usable as a plural
D is the Roman numeral for five hundred
L is the abbreviation for pounds sterling, from the Latin libra

explanation.surface: Nasty crooks pocketing five hundred pounds through a con.
explanation.definitionFit: To swindle is to obtain money by deception, synonymous with to defraud.

clue.text: Cat flap alongside

parts.note: a tab is a small flap or strip attached to something
by means beside or next to

explanation.surface: A cat flap beside something, the pet's door.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cat flap' reads as one thing, but the definition is just 'Cat'.
explanation.definitionFit: A tabby is a domestic cat with a striped or mottled coat.

clue.text: Bedding plant — a big one, unfortunately

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things went wrong, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A gardener rueing a bedding plant that has grown too large.
explanation.definitionFit: Begonias are popular flowering plants grown in beds and borders for summer colour.

clue.text: Radar is repaired with end of messy clutter

indicators.note: repaired means fixed by being put back together differently, so these letters are rearranged
end of picks the final letter of the word messy

explanation.surface: A radar set being fixed amid messy clutter in a workshop.
explanation.definitionFit: A state of untidiness or confusion, a jumble of things, is a synonym for clutter.

clue.text: Department chasing a very skilled operator

indicators.note: chasing means following behind, so this piece comes after the other

explanation.surface: A government department hunting down a highly skilled practitioner.
explanation.definitionFit: An adept is an expert, a person thoroughly proficient at something.

clue.text: Presented a hammer used by auctioneers mostly

indicators.note: mostly means most but not all, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a gavel is the small mallet an auctioneer bangs to close a sale

explanation.surface: An auctioneer's hammer handed over as a gift.
explanation.definitionFit: Gave is the past tense of give, meaning presented or handed over.

clue.text: I got on board wrong express

indicators.note: getting on board means going inside a vessel, so this letter goes inside the word

parts.note: vice is wrongdoing, moral wrong
as printed this gives I, but the answer needs O here: the setter's slip

explanation.surface: Someone boarded the wrong express train by mistake.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue is faulty: I inside VICE makes VIICE, not the answer. The editor admitted the error; with O in place of I, 'got on board' puts O inside VICE.
explanation.definitionFit: To voice an opinion is to express it, to put it into words.

clue.text: Unfinished commercial initially broadcast widely, for example

indicators.note: unfinished means lacking its ending, so the last letter goes

parts.note: an advert is a commercial, a paid announcement

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of the word broadcast

explanation.surface: An incomplete commercial was first shown far and wide.
explanation.walkthrough: 'widely' reads as part of the surface about broadcasting, but it is the example in the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Widely is an example of a word class that modifies verbs, typically ending in -ly.

clue.text: Tin managed to open

parts.note: a can is a tin container
did means managed, as in 'did well'

explanation.surface: Someone succeeded in opening a tin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'open' looks like a verb to go with the tin, but it is the adjective meaning frank.
explanation.definitionFit: Candid means frank and honest, open in what one says.

clue.text: Young reporter's association — that's not large

indicators.note: that's not means the following letter is excluded from the word

parts.note: a club is an association of members
L is the abbreviation for large, as on clothing sizes

explanation.surface: A trainee journalist's professional body, which is only small.
explanation.definitionFit: A cub reporter is a newspaper slang term for an inexperienced journalist.

clue.text: Exposed threat a new bee represented

indicators.note: re-presented means presented again in a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A new bee posed a threat that someone was exposed to.
explanation.definitionFit: Weather-beaten describes something worn by long exposure to wind and rain.
